note: Programme for the Japanese Day of Tea and Culture 2026. Programme subject to change.

items.title: Welcome and opening remarks
items.description: Opening remarks by a representative of the Embassy of Japan in the Czech Republic, a representative of the City of Chýně and the event organiser.

items.title: Aikido Chýně
items.description: A demonstration of the traditional Japanese martial art of aikido. Aikido Chýně is led by Václav Plánský, holder of 1st dan Aikikai.

items.title: Marek Hora
items.description: An ambassador of Japanese cuisine in the Czech Republic and a respected chef active in both Europe and Japan. Marek Hora is the owner of Prague restaurant Yamaya. On stage, he will fillet a fresh hamachi and demonstrate expert sushi preparation.

items.title: Noriko Komiyama
items.description: A certified ikebana instructor of the Sogetsu school. She will introduce the differences between two renowned schools – Ikenobo (池坊流) and Sogetsu (草月流) – and show how striking ikebana arrangements can be created from readily available flowers.

items.title: Nihon Bunka Plzeň
items.description: A demonstration of traditional kimono dressing. On stage, they will dress a representative of the City of Chýně in kimono and explain the symbolism and meaning of the individual elements of traditional Japanese clothing.

items.title: Gorin – Samurai Show
items.description: A samurai show featuring combat scenes inspired by the battlefields of Japan's Sengoku period.

items.title: Markéta Franová
items.description: A demonstration of kamigata-mai, a traditional solo dance style from the Osaka and Kyoto region, characterised by elegance, restrained movement and refined use of the folding fan.

items.title: Aikido Chýně
items.description: A second demonstration of the traditional Japanese martial art of aikido.

items.title: San Dó Mon Kendo Klub Praha
items.description: San Dó Mon Kendo Klub Praha will present kendo, the Japanese martial art rooted in the tradition of swordsmanship.

items.title: Aska Pluskal
items.description: A singer originally from Okinawa, Aska Pluskal will perform traditional and contemporary Japanese songs.

items.title: Budō Plzeň
items.description: Budō Plzeň will present iaido, a traditional Japanese martial art focused on the use of the Japanese sword.

items.title: Tomáš Pelich
items.description: A musical performance on the traditional Japanese bamboo flute shakuhachi by Tomáš Pelich from the Shibumi meditation garden.

items.title: Gorin – Samurai Archery
items.description: A demonstration of samurai archery and traditional Japanese bow technique, accompanied by live commentary.

items.title: Yosakoi Hanamaru (Prague)
items.description: Yosakoi Hanamaru Prague will present the energetic Japanese dance style yosakoi, combining traditional elements with contemporary music and choreography.

items.title: Radka Tůmová
items.description: Radka Tůmová will introduce Japanese family crests, kamon (家紋), traditional symbols used to identify families and lineages. She will explain their history, meaning and parallels with the European heraldic tradition.

items.title: Gorin – Tameshigiri
items.description: A demonstration of tameshigiri – the traditional practice of test-cutting rolled mats with a Japanese katana.

items.title: Closing programme and Best Kimono competition announcement
